options.name: domain_server
options.description: The FQDN of the domain controller to target for all operations. When not specified, the module uses the default domain controller discovery.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the GPO link is enabled. When not specified during creation, the link defaults to enabled.

options.name: enforced
options.description: Whether the GPO link is enforced (No Override). When not specified during creation, the link defaults to not enforced.

options.name: guid
options.description: The GUID of the GPO to link. Mutually exclusive with O(name). One of O(name) or O(guid) must be provided.

options.name: name
options.description: The display name of the GPO to link. Mutually exclusive with O(guid). One of O(name) or O(guid) must be provided.

options.name: order
options.description: The link order (1-based) for the GPO on the target container. Lower numbers have higher precedence.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the GPO link should be present or absent on the target.

options.name: target
options.description: The distinguished name of the container (OU, domain, or site) to which the GPO should be linked. Example: V(OU=Servers,DC=contoso,DC=com).
